trigger: I am a journalist being stopped for my work
description: What to do if you are stopped, searched or detained because of reporting or filming.

steps.text: Stay calm and identify yourself as a journalist if it is safe to do so.
You have a right to freedom of expression, including the press (s.39).
Do not hand over or delete your footage; ask on what authority it is demanded.
If detained, ask on what grounds (s.35(3)) and remain silent until your lawyer comes.
Note the officers' names, numbers, location and time.
Contact your editor, lawyer, or a trusted colleague.
Back up your material as soon as you safely can.
